title: 雨衣 · The Raincoat
logline: 凌晨三点的便利店，店员从监控里看见一个雨衣顾客站了很久；等他走到货架尽头，人不见了，货架上只剩一件还在滴水的雨衣。
poster_frame: S04 — the dripping raincoat hanging on an empty shelf hook, the clerk's hand frozen an inch from the sleeve, cold fridge light raking across the wet PVC.

style.look: photoreal night interior, documentary stillness, no stylization
style.palette: cold fluorescent white and pale green; one warm red price tag is the only warm accent in frame
style.grade: flat contrast, crushed blacks down the aisles, no teal-orange, no film emulation LUT
style.texture: wet linoleum with tracked-in footprints, condensation on fridge glass, dust on every horizontal surface
style.optics: shot on a full-frame sensor through anamorphic glass at T2, 1/48s shutter, elliptical bokeh, mild chromatic fringing at the frame edges, halation blooming off the fluorescent tubes, highlight rolloff instead of clipped white, no sharpening halos, no CGI sheen

audio.ambience: fluorescent ballast hum, fridge compressor cycling, rain on the glass front

characters.name: 夜班店员
characters.anchor: a 22-year-old male night clerk, 178cm, tired narrow eyes with dark under-circles, black hair flattened by a blue uniform cap, faint stubble on the jaw, a small split on the right knuckle, blue convenience-store polo two sizes too big, sleeves rolled once, name tag worn askew, black trousers, gray sneakers

characters.name: 雨衣顾客
characters.anchor: an adult figure in a dark green PVC raincoat, hood up, face entirely in shadow under the brim, sleeves too long covering the hands, water beading and running off the PVC, no visible skin, height 172cm

characters.name: 滴水雨衣
characters.anchor: a dark green PVC raincoat, hood up and empty as a shell, still beaded all over with water, sleeves hanging straight down, one shoulder seam gone pale with wear

locations.name: 便利店前场
locations.anchor: a 24-hour convenience store at 3 a.m., 4-meter white tile floor, laminate checkout counter with a worn crescent, hot-snack case, cigarette rack behind the register, one hanging red price tag, fluorescent tube fixtures in a grid, automatic glass door with rain streaking down it

locations.name: 货架通道
locations.anchor: a narrow aisle of waist-high shelves, refrigerated display along the back wall with fogged glass doors, instant-noodle pallet at the aisle mouth, wire shelf hooks, peeling price labels, wet footprints tracking down the tile

shots.beat: 他擦着柜台，眼睛却黏在监控小屏上
shots.subject: {{CHAR_A}}
action: wipes the counter in slow circles with a gray rag, eyes fixed off-frame on the monitor
his hand slows, then stops mid-circle
shots.wardrobe: blue polo with a frayed collar thread standing up, name tag hanging at 15 degrees, rag gray and thinning at the fold
shots.atmosphere: fluorescent light flickering once on the left fixture; rain sliding down the glass door behind him
shots.physics: the rag dragging, wet laminate squeaking under it; his shoulders pulled slightly toward the screen
shots.lighting: flat cold tubes straight down from the ceiling grid, hard shadow under the cap brim, a second weak reflection of the tubes on the wet counter, the aisles behind him falling to black
shots.camera: holds a slow 6% push-in, drifting half a degree left, ending when his hand stops
shots.lens: 40mm anamorphic at T2.8, focus on his eyes, the glass door soft behind
timeline: 0.0–1.8s | he wipes the counter in slow circles, breathing through his mouth, eyes already off-frame toward the monitor
1.8–4.2s | the circles shorten; he leans his weight onto the rag hand, jaw tightening
4.2–5.6s | the hand stops mid-circle, rag still pressed flat against the laminate
5.6–7.0s | he lifts his chin toward the monitor, one blink, breath held
micro: the laminate counter worn matte in a crescent where elbows rest, edges polished by years of forearms
the rag leaves a wet arc that starts drying from its edges inward while he is still wiping
dried ramen broth stuck to the hot-snack case, browned and cracked at the rim
the frayed collar thread standing up and trembling with his breath
a split on his right knuckle, shiny and tight, catching one hard highlight
price-gun ink smudge across his thumbnail, half washed off
a fly strip curling above the register, its surface dull with age
shots.continuity: same clerk, same polo, same counter geometry as every later shot; the red price tag stays frame-right in the background

shots.beat: 监控屏里，雨衣人一动不动地站在货架前
shots.subject: a 7-inch security monitor mounted above the register, its grainy feed showing {{CHAR_B}} standing motionless at the aisle end
action: the grainy feed shows the raincoat figure standing motionless at the end of the aisle
a single scanline rolls up the screen
shots.setting: {{LOC_STORE}}, monitor bezel scratched, dead pixel column on the left edge
shots.atmosphere: screen backlight bleeding into the dark around the bezel; dust on the glass catching it
shots.physics: the feed's low frame rate making the figure's stillness read as a held image; droplets falling in the feed at a stutter
shots.lighting: the monitor is the only source in frame: cold blue-white spill onto the bezel, everything else near black, the clerk's shoulder a dark shape at the frame edge
shots.camera: locked off, no movement, then a 3% push-in on the last second
shots.lens: 100mm macro at T4, screen pixels just resolving, bezel falling out of focus
timeline: 0.0–2.0s | the feed holds: raincoat figure at the aisle end, hood up, water dripping from the hem
2.0–3.6s | one scanline rolls top to bottom; the figure does not move a pixel
3.6–5.0s | the timestamp digits tick over in the corner, white on black, slightly blooming
5.0–6.0s | a slow 3% push-in; the figure's shadow pool on the wet tile is the only thing that changes
micro: monitor bezel scratched in short parallel strokes, one deep gouge catching the backlight
a dead pixel column running down the left edge, permanently dark
visible scanlines and sensor grain in the feed, worse in the shadows
the raincoat figure rendered at low resolution, edges smeared by compression
droplets falling from the hem in the feed, each one a two-frame smear
dust settled on the screen glass, lit from behind, brighter than the image
timestamp digits in the corner, white on black, overexposed at the stroke centers
shots.continuity: the monitor geometry and the aisle in the feed match S03's real aisle exactly: same shelf heights, same red tag position
sound: the clerk's breath close to the mic

shots.beat: 他走进通道，尽头是空的
shots.subject: {{CHAR_A}}
action: walks down the aisle toward the refrigerated wall, head turning slightly left and right
stops at the aisle end and looks at the empty floor
shots.wardrobe: polo untucked at the back, cap pushed up with one hand, gray sneakers squeaking on wet tile
shots.atmosphere: cold air from the open fridge door pushing a faint fog across the floor; one tube flickering at the aisle mouth
shots.physics: his weight landing unevenly, the wet floor grabbing each sole; shelf hooks swaying after he passes
shots.lighting: fridge light from the back wall as the key, cold and green-white, his body a silhouette with a rim along the shoulder; ceiling tubes as flat fill from above; the aisle mouth behind him falling into darkness
shots.camera: follows him from behind at a walking pace, then stops as he stops, holding the empty end of the aisle
shots.lens: 32mm anamorphic at T2, deep enough to read the whole aisle, the fridge glass blooming
timeline: 0.0–2.2s | he steps into the aisle, one hand still holding the rag, head turning left
2.2–4.4s | he walks; the camera follows at his pace, shelf hooks swaying as he passes
4.4–6.2s | he slows, then stops; his reflection slides across the fogged fridge glass and vanishes
6.2–8.0s | he stands at the empty aisle end, breathing, looking down at the wet floor where somebody should be
micro: floor tiles scuffed in a dark trail from a pallet jack, one tile cracked corner to corner
condensation on the fridge doors, one clean drip track cut through the fog
hanging price tags still swaying from his passing, strings twisted
his dim reflection sliding across the fridge glass, lagging half a step behind him
a pallet of instant noodles at the aisle mouth, shrink-wrap torn at the corner, cardboard furred with moisture
a gray wad of chewing gum fused to the tile, flattened by a hundred shoes
cold air spilling from the open fridge door, moving the loose hem of his polo
shots.continuity: same aisle geography as the S02 monitor feed: same shelf heights, same red tag frame-right, same fridge wall at the end
sound: a shelf hook ticking as it settles
shots.speaker: CHAR_A

shots.beat: 货架钩上挂着一件滴水雨衣，他的手停在半寸之外
shots.subject: the right hand and forearm of {{CHAR_A}}
action: the raincoat hangs from the hook and drips onto the tile
his fingertips stop an inch from the sleeve, trembling
shots.wardrobe: his sleeve rolled once, forearm hair wet, the knuckle split reopened and beading
shots.setting: {{LOC_AISLE}}, with {{PROP_RAINCOAT}} hanging from a bare wire hook at eye height, a peeling price label reading 4.5 on the shelf lip below
shots.atmosphere: cold air from the fridge door moving the raincoat hem a few millimeters; a drip line on the tile leading back three meters
shots.physics: the PVC heavy with water, its weight pulling the hook slightly down; each drip landing with a small spread on the tile
shots.lighting: fridge light raking from the right through the fogged glass, throwing a wet sheen down the raincoat's folds; hard shadow of the hook on the shelf behind; his hand lit only at the fingertips
shots.camera: his hand enters frame from the left; locked off, then a 4% push toward the sleeve on the last two seconds
shots.lens: 75mm at T2, the raincoat sharp, the aisle dissolving behind it
timeline: 0.0–1.6s | the raincoat hangs, one drop gathering at the hem and falling
1.6–3.4s | his hand enters from the left, slow, fingers spread, stopping short of the sleeve
3.4–5.2s | the hem shifts a few millimeters in the cold air; his fingers tremble, not touching
5.2–7.0s | a 4% push toward the wet PVC; the drip line on the floor leads back out of frame
micro: PVC still beaded all over, water running down the folds in thin branching threads
the raincoat's shoulder seam gone pale where it has been worn, one stitch pulled
the wire hook straightened slightly under the weight, its paint chipped to bare metal
a drip line on the tile leading back three meters, individual drops spaced unevenly
the price label peeling at one corner, '4.5' faded to gray
his fingertips pale and pruned from the wet rag, tremor visible at the nail edge
the split knuckle reopened, a bead of blood thinned by water
shots.continuity: same aisle end as S03, now occupied; the raincoat is the only object that moved between shots
sound: a single drip hitting tile, then another
